findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_tickers" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Symbol and instrument directory search across 66,400+ global equities, ETFs, FX pairs, indices and cryptocurrencies by company name or ticker symbol. Supports o…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
